summary: Markdown MCP package ships Alibaba Cloud / Kubernetes credential-reconnaissance toolchain
details: Package is advertised as a Markdown MCP server (table-of-contents / stats / table helpers) but the tarball ships a full credential-reconnaissance toolchain in build115.js, build116.js, rewrite111.js, patch108-112.js, and rebuild.js. These files construct an index.js that probes the Alibaba Cloud ECS instance metadata service at http://100.100.100.200/latest/api/token and http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/ using IMDSv2 token headers to lift RAM security credentials, and reads Kubernetes service-account tokens at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token, /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, /root/.ssh/id_rsa, /var/www/html/.env, and /proc/self/mountinfo. The shipped index.js header openly documents this behavior and the generated index.js ends with a v2Probe() invocation. In 1.1.6 the main entry defines fetchText2 but does not reach the probe at import time (syncDone is referenced undefined), so the harvesting code is present and generatable but not auto-executed by this specific version's main — however the complete attack chain is distributed in the artifact and the declared package purpose is an unrelated cover for cloud/container credential theft.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
